## Changed in meaning

### `R-A-002`

Added an obligation that did not exist. The original said only when rowRef must be null; the revision also requires it to name the row in every other case. An implementation that emitted null everywhere satisfied the old text and fails the new one.

**Was:** `article21.rowRef` SHALL be `null` when `applicability` is `none`. A null here is a legal, expected value.

**Now:** `article21.rowRef` SHALL be `null` when `applicability` is `none`, and SHALL name the row otherwise. A null here is a legal, expected value.
### `R-M-012`

Two changes, both binding. Class 0,1 S / 0.1 was added to the permitted set, which relaxes the rule; and the record must now carry the standard and edition the class is claimed under, plus the meter serial and calibration date as before, which adds required fields. A conforming 0.1 record can be missing the edition.

**Was:** A revenue meter SHALL be of accuracy class **IEC 62053-22 class 0.2S or 0.5S**, or **ANSI C12.20 class 0.2 or 0.5**, and the record SHALL carry its class, serial number and calibration certificate…

**Now:** A revenue meter SHALL be of accuracy class **0,1 S, 0,2 S or 0,5 S** per IEC 62053-22:2020, or **0.1, 0.2 or 0.5** per ANSI C12.20, and the record SHALL carry its class, the standard and edition the…
